title: Sales Tax Rates and Exemption Terms for Commercial Natural Gas Supply
content:
Beacon Ridge collects state sales tax on Commercial Natural Gas Supply charges at the rate of the site's service state. The rates and the exemption terms are the same on all six plans.

## State sales tax rates

| Service state | Sales tax rate on commercial gas supply charges (percent) |
|---|---|
| Pennsylvania (PA) | 6.000 |
| New Jersey (NJ) | 6.625 |
| Maryland (MD) | 6.000 |
| Ohio (OH) | 0.000 |
| Illinois (IL) | 0.000 |

These rates apply on every plan: Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index, Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12, Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12, Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24, Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 and Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24.

## Exemption terms

| Plan | From which cycle a sales tax exemption applies | Tax billed before the exemption refunded by Beacon Ridge |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | Cycles beginning on or after the tax exemption date | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | Cycles beginning on or after the tax exemption date | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | Cycles beginning on or after the tax exemption date | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | Cycles beginning on or after the tax exemption date | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | Cycles beginning on or after the tax exemption date | No |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | Cycles beginning on or after the tax exemption date | No |

## Notes

- A site in Ohio or Illinois carries a rate of 0.000 percent.
- An exemption works forward only: it reaches billing cycles that begin on or after the tax exemption date, and tax already billed for earlier cycles is not refunded by Beacon Ridge.
